notes.title: 5 YEARS AGO A CHICKEN WAS BORN!
notes.content:
[b]HEY GUYS!!! Boy, it's been a long time since I have posted any updates or news about this game. First off though, Happy Anniversary to WHY CHICKEN? WHY? !!! This game was released on Steam 5 years ago to this day. Long story short, currently I am not able to update the game itself any further because I need to try and retrieve the file off my old PC that won't boot...lol. So the chicken will have to remain as it is for now. I hope to update it someday though. I did this project to mostly prove to myself I could finish and release a game, but wanted to make something fun & old school. Are there bugs? Probably...Should I have used consistent art & non-paid assets? Yep. ...Should my text fonts all been the same in the UI. For sure. Did I do any marketing? Not much....These are all failures I'm willing to take to learn & live my dream of game creation. Stay tuned for announcements on my upcoming project (MALOIK: THE METAL HAND). A platformer/metroidvania with a heavy metal theme. \m/[/b]

notes.title: 2 Week Discount Sale!
notes.content:
Hello,

Today (4/11/2019) begins a two week sale of Why Chicken? Why?.
For all those wishlister's that haven't given the game a try, now is your chance.
Also, coming in May will be some extra content added to the game in the form of 3 mini-games (separate from the main game). Please be sure to leave a review if you end up purchasing the game. The May update will also feature some new achievements and extra goodies. Thanks for stopping by! #Feathers4Life

notes.title: Any ideas for achievements? Did you buy or review the game?
notes.content:
Hi,

Just want you all to know I'm still updating most aspects of my game's social presence every day and plan do come up with some new achievements in the game soon.
If you have any ideas for them I'd be happy to hear.

So far I've determined I've made about 8+ or so sales. I'm not arguing, Pretty happy actually. :) Would just love to see some of those wishlisters pull the trigger and fall in love with Feathers.

If you have bought the game I'd very much appreciate a review.
It really helps me out in more ways than one.

Anyways, just thought I'd post another update.

I also have 10 free keys still I'd like to give out. So send me a Steam friend request and mention this post & I'd be happy to send you one for a fair review of my game after some decent playtime. Thanks everyone!
My newest game/s are already in development. Soon to be shared. ;)

J.R.
Number77Studios
